ComplexCalculator.add:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds the real and imaginary components of two complex inputs and returns a new complex number built from the summed parts." add]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> c1 </REF>: complex "First complex number to add."
        <REF> c2 </REF>: complex "Second complex number to add."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: complex "Complex number whose real and imaginary parts are the sums of the corresponding parts of the inputs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the sum of the real parts of c1 and c2 and store it in real. RESULT real]
            [COMMAND Compute the sum of the imaginary parts of c1 and c2 and store it in imaginary. RESULT imaginary]
            [COMMAND Construct a complex number from real and imaginary and store it in answer. RESULT answer]
            [COMMAND Return answer as the method result. RESULT answer]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ComplexCalculator.subtract:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Subtracts the real and imaginary parts of the second complex number from the first and returns the resulting complex number." subtract]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> c1 </REF>: complex "First complex number providing the minuend values for real and imaginary parts."
        <REF> c2 </REF>: complex "Second complex number providing the subtrahend values for real and imaginary parts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: complex "A complex number whose real part is c1.real minus c2.real and whose imaginary part is c1.imag minus c2.imag."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the real component of the result as c1.real minus c2.real. RESULT real]
            [COMMAND Compute the imaginary component of the result as c1.imag minus c2.imag. RESULT imaginary]
            [COMMAND Construct and return a complex number from the computed real and imaginary components. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ComplexCalculator.multiply:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Multiplies two complex numbers by computing the real and imaginary parts of their product and returning a new complex value." multiply]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> c1 </REF>: complex "First complex number whose real and imaginary components are used in the multiplication."
        <REF> c2 </REF>: complex "Second complex number whose real and imaginary components are used in the multiplication."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: complex "A new complex number containing the computed real and imaginary parts of the product."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the real part of the product as c1.real * c2.real - c1.imag * c2.imag. RESULT real]
            [COMMAND Compute the imaginary part of the product as c1.real * c2.imag + c1.imag * c2.real. RESULT imaginary]
            [COMMAND Return a new complex number constructed from the computed real and imaginary parts. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ComplexCalculator.divide:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Divides one complex number by another by computing the quotient from the real and imaginary components and returning the resulting complex value." divide]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> c1 </REF>: complex "Dividend complex number whose real and imaginary parts are used in the quotient calculation."
        <REF> c2 </REF>: complex "Divisor complex number whose real and imaginary parts are used to build the shared denominator and numerators."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: complex "The complex quotient c1 / c2 computed from component-wise arithmetic."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the shared denominator as c2.real squared plus c2.imag squared. RESULT denominator]
            [COMMAND Compute the quotient real part as (c1.real * c2.real + c1.imag * c2.imag) divided by denominator. RESULT real]
            [COMMAND Compute the quotient imaginary part as (c1.imag * c2.real - c1.real * c2.imag) divided by denominator. RESULT imaginary]
            [COMMAND Return a complex number built from the computed real and imaginary parts. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The computed denominator is zero, which occurs when both c2.real and c2.imag are zero and causes division by zero during the quotient calculations.]
        [LOG "Division by zero would occur while computing the real or imaginary component of the quotient."]
        [THROW ZeroDivisionError "Raised implicitly by division when the divisor complex number has zero magnitude."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
